name: hermajan/imagony
description: Symfony bundle and Twig extension for thumbnail generation.

suggest.ext-gd: GD driver. Needs WebP/AVIF support compiled in for those formats (docker-php-ext-configure gd --with-webp --with-avif)
suggest.ext-imagick: Imagick driver, preferred when present. Needs an ImageMagick with WebP/AVIF delegates for those formats
suggest.symfony/console: Provides `bin/console imagony:check` which diagnoses missing PHP image extensions and configuration problems
